AST inspection confirms cat-file -p / git show on the gate path and archive confined to measurement. validate.py REACH-6 LF-normalises before hashing (lf_norm=True, blobread=False, catalog_allowed=True, pass=True) — the catalog's allowed alternative to `git cat-file -p`. .gitattributes present=True; rules/common/windows-shell.md present=True; schema pack present=True. This unit's write_receipts.py LF-normalises before hashing. SUCCESS:WFA-0012

signal_a.method: same commit: hash_gate(git cat-file -p) on the Windows-like eol=crlf worktree versus hash_gate(LF-normalised copy) versus the CI blob digest

signal_b.method: delta_bytes = len(CRLF worktree) - len(LF blob); for a pure EOL conversion this equals line_count. LF-normalised identity is required so a same-length content substitution is not classed as newline noise.
